title: 从建筑照片到可组装的纸灯
title_en: From architecture photos to a paper lamp
summary: OpenAI 团队以芝加哥 Marina City 的阳台为灵感，用 Astra 迭代 CAD 设计并生成纸灯定制网站，最后手工组装实物。
summary_en: OpenAI used Astra to iterate a CAD design inspired by Marina City and generate a lamp-builder website. The team assembled the physical lamp by hand.
author: OpenAI
evidenceBasis: OpenAI 团队以芝加哥 Marina City 的阳台为灵感，用 Astra 迭代 CAD 设计并生成纸灯定制网站，最后手工组装实物。

title: Plotly：43 道数据分析任务测试
summary: Plotly 在合成风电数据仓库中测试 GPT-6.2 Astra，报告答对 41/43 题、漏掉两项隐藏模式；同页记录 Sol 为 40/43。每个模型只跑一次，不能将一两分差距当作稳定结论。
summary_en: Plotly tests GPT-6.2 Astra on a synthetic wind-energy warehouse, reporting 41/43 with two missed hidden patterns; Sol scores 40/43. Each model has one run, so small differences may reflect run variance.
author: Plotly
